text:
jamie: heads-up  scheduling a short maintenance window to push kernel-compat shim + a quant microbuild (int8-v3-regen). window: 23:30-00:30 UTC. plan: 2% canary -> 20% -> 100% if all clear. tagging oncall.

sora: add matmul-smoke + kv-warm probe in preflight. also want bundle-checksum across staging.

deploybot: [scheduled] release created: rb/quant-micro-2026-04-02 (canary 2%). start=23:30 UTC. notify=#eng-runtime

oncall-sre: I'm Mira, on-watch for that slot. PD alerts set for error-rate delta >3% or p99 +200ms.

release-eng: I'll draft release notes; need fallback variant name and rollback bullets.

jamie: fallback -> engine:compat-stable for standard, engine:compat-thermal for hot nodes. rollback triggers: error-rate >3% sustained 5m OR p99 tail +200ms for 5m. pin TTL=75m (auto-unpin 01:00 UTC).

sora: preflight checklist: 1) bundle-checksum on 4 staging shards 2) matmul-smoke 3) kv-cache warmup probe 4) shadow 1% traffic for 10m. abort on checksum mismatch.

deploybot: command: /release start rb/quant-micro-2026-04-02 --canary=2 --ttl=75m --notify #eng-runtime

release-eng: draft note: "rb/quant-micro-2026-04-02: kernel-compat shim + quant=int8-v3-regen. Fallback: engine:compat-stable / compat-thermal. Rollback: error/p99 thresholds + checksum gate." will publish pre-start.

oncall-sre: I'll watch metrics and traces. PagerDuty contact: mira(oncall-sre).

sora: manual emergency rollback snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/release/shift \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"release":"rb/quant-micro-2026-04-02","to":0,"fallback":"engine:compat-stable"}'
```

deploybot: [running] canary started 23:30 UTC at 2%. metrics endpoint: /metrics/release/rb/quant-micro-2026-04-02

oncall-sre: seeing a small p95 blip +18ms at +5m, no error rise. holding watch.

jamie: enabling immediate fallback routing for any 5xx on canary bucket. noisy customers should drop to compat quickly.

release-eng: release notes published internal: https://docs.internal/releases/rb-quant-micro-2026-04-02  cc support/product.

deploybot: [status] promoted to 20% at 23:55 UTC.

oncall-sre: brief p99 spike to 210ms for 2m after promotion, no error-rate change. marked transient.

sora: running a targeted tail probe on thermal hosts now, results look stable.

jamie: OK to promote to 100% in 15m if no alerts. reminder: clear canary pin and paste final build sha to runbook after.

deploybot: [done] rollout completed 00:08 UTC. build hash: sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900aabbccdd.

oncall-sre: no PDs triggered. closing watch.

release-eng: clearing pin and updating runbook with hash + notes. thanks team :tada:
